title: Community Gardens
passage: Community gardens are becoming popular in many cities. Local governments provide shared spaces where people who do not have yards at home can grow vegetables and flowers. Working together also has a benefit: gardeners often make new friends. Some cities also let children grow vegetables in the gardens. In this way, the children can learn about nature. Many cities plan to build more of them.

title: Beach Cleanup Events
passage: Many towns by the sea hold beach cleanup events during the summer. Volunteers of all ages walk along the beach and pick up empty bottles and cans, which prevents them from being carried out to sea. Some towns also invite tourists to join the events. In this way, visitors can learn about the local environment. Many people say that taking part raises their awareness of trash.
passageJa: 海に面した多くの町が、夏のあいだに海岸の清掃イベントを開く。あらゆる年齢のボランティアが海岸を歩き、空きびんや空き缶を拾うので、それらが波にさらわれて海に出ていくのを防げる。観光客をイベントに招く町もある。こうして、訪れた人はその土地の環境について学ぶことができる。参加すると、ごみへの意識が高まる、と言う人は多い。

title: Bicycle Sharing
passage: In many cities, bicycle-sharing services are becoming popular. These services provide bicycles that people can borrow at one station and return at another. Many tourists use them, too, because the bicycles are available at any time of the day. Some cities are building more stations near train stations. In this way, they make it easier for people to move around the city. Bicycles are also good for the environment.
passageJa: 多くの都市で、自転車のシェアリングサービスが人気になってきている。こうしたサービスは自転車を用意していて、人々はあるステーションで借りて、別のステーションで返すことができる。自転車は1日のどの時間でも使えるので、観光客もよく利用する。駅の近くにステーションを増やしている都市もある。こうして、人々が街の中を移動しやすくしている。自転車は環境にもよい。

title: Short-Term Study Abroad
passage: Many high schools now give students an opportunity to join short study programs abroad. Students stay with local families for two or three weeks and take classes at a school there. They also try to speak English with their host families every day. In this way, they can improve their language skills. Some students make friends there and keep in touch with them after returning home.
passageJa: 多くの高校が、いまでは生徒に短期の海外留学プログラムに参加する機会を与えている。生徒は2、3週間、現地の家庭に滞在し、そこの学校で授業を受ける。毎日、ホストファミリーと英語で話すようにもしている。こうして、語学力を伸ばすことができる。現地で友だちをつくり、帰国後も連絡を取り合う生徒もいる。
